// Synthetic old-SDK host helpers are the exact upstream runtime_contract prefix.
// This test calls the actual registered plugin; never reimplements its reducer.
#[test]
fn export_registered_control_actions_for_native_comparison() {
    let api = PluginApi {
        abi_version:rpi_plugin_sdk::RPI_PLUGIN_ABI_VERSION_UNIFIED,
        struct_size:std::mem::size_of::<PluginApi>() as u32,free_string,
        register_tool:Some(register_tool),register_command:Some(register_command),
        register_shortcut:None,register_flag:None,register_provider:None,
        register_message_renderer:None,register_markdown_transformer:None,
        register_entry_renderer:None,register_event_handler:Some(register_event),
        register_resources_discover:None,runtime_action:runtime,dispatch_event:None,
        user_data:std::ptr::null_mut(),declare:None,register_before_agent_start:None,
        register_oauth_provider:None,
    };
    assert_eq!(rpi_durable::rpi_plugin_register(&api),0);
    assert_eq!(empty(EventTag::SessionStart),0);
    let fixture:Value=serde_json::from_str(include_str!("control-trace.json")).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fixture["frames"].as_array().unwrap().len(),17);
    let mut exported=Vec::new();
    for (index,frame) in fixture["frames"].as_array().unwrap().iter().enumerate() {
        let params=frame.get("action").cloned().unwrap_or_else(||json!({"action":"status"}));
        let result=action(params).unwrap();
        let mut raw=result["details"].clone();
        assert!(raw.get("error").is_none(),"{result}");
        raw.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("action").unwrap();
        let expected:rpi_durable_core::DurableState=serde_json::from_value(frame["expected"].clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(expected).unwrap(),raw,"literal frame {index}");
        let entries=host().lock().unwrap().entries.clone();
        assert_eq!(entries.len(),index);
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(rpi_durable_core::DurableState::try_from_branch(&entries).unwrap()).unwrap(),raw);
        let reads=host().lock().unwrap().read_requests.len();
        let status=action(json!({"action":"status"})).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(status["details"]["revision"],index);
        assert_eq!(host().lock().unwrap().entries,entries);
        assert_eq!(host().lock().unwrap().read_requests.len(),reads);
        exported.push(json!({"index":index,"action":frame.get("action"),"state":raw,
            "entryCount":entries.len(),"entryId":entries.last().map(|entry|entry["id"].clone())}));
    }
    let entries=host().lock().unwrap().entries.clone();
    assert_eq!(entries[0]["data"]["kind"],"snapshot");
    assert_eq!(entries[0]["data"]["revision"],1);
    assert_eq!(empty(EventTag::SessionTree),0);
    assert_eq!(host().lock().unwrap().entries,entries);
    let artifact=json!({"schema":"rpi-synthetic-legacy-control-differential-v1",
        "legacyCommit":"041c981b21ac42348feee371757f5ef26ecbdcab",
        "pluginSha256":"0f4be632b1f5dab5dfa0ac9cf55bb9119b1a37ec3ac195f08161dca9480fdaac",
        "traceSha256":"3aa91d01e3e92a10b34b4e89a923802537437f6076b359edb2d2b4bfad050343",
        "frames":exported,"entries":entries});
    // Path is set only by the isolated runner to its own TempDir, not a real
    // journal/config or import target. create_new prevents overwriting any file.
    let path=std::env::var_os("RPI_SYNTHETIC_LEGACY_CONTROL_EXPORT").expect("explicit synthetic export path");
    use std::io::Write;
    let mut file=std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create_new(true).write(true).open(path).unwrap();
    file.write_all(serde_json::to_string(&artifact).unwrap().as_bytes()).unwrap();
}
